C. A. 1st Cir. [Certiorari granted, 515 U. S. 1191.] Motions of Howard C. Anawalt and Software Protection Committee of Minnesota Intellectual Property Law Association for leave to file briefs as amici curiae granted.

Justice Stevens took no part in the consideration or decision of these motions.
